introHtml: Safety colored school spirit items combine high-visibility hues like neon yellow, orange, and lime green with your school logo or mascot. These products are ideal for safety fairs, pep rallies, and outdoor events where visibility matters. Choose from custom wristbands, lanyards, and drawstring bags made with reflective or bright materials that keep students and staff noticeable while showing school pride.
